label: preserve-overrun-inventory-and-own-failed-test
command:
import json
import os
import shutil
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
run_id = "b599095296434883b5ce699bef58c6f8"
run_root = root / ".nisayon/runs" / run_id
run = json.loads((run_root / "run.json").read_text())
assert run["process_status"] == "nonzero" and run["ended_at"]
assert run["cwd"] == str(root) and run["command"] == ["make", "check"]
temporary = Path("/private/var/folders/fl/_txhnxc90xl00n3xtq0r4nq40000gn/T/pytest-of-danielwahnich/pytest-229").resolve(strict=True)
failed = "test_a_confirmation_decided_la0"
assert not temporary.is_symlink() and temporary.stat().st_uid == os.getuid()
assert not (temporary / ".lock").exists()
assert str(temporary / failed) in (run_root / "stdout.log").read_text()
output = root / "docs/experiments/results/engine-resource-control-001"
output.mkdir()
before = []
for path in sorted(temporary.rglob("*")):
    if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink():
        before.append({"path":str(path.relative_to(temporary)), "bytes":path.stat().st_size, "sha256":file_digest(path)})
preserved = [item for item in before if item["path"].startswith(failed + "/")]
assert len(preserved) == 5
inventory = {"schema":"nisayon.test-temporary-inventory.v1","created_at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"root":str(temporary),"run":run_id,"run_sha256":file_digest(run_root / "run.json"),"ownership_evidence":"Completed lane-local command, exact pytest root in failure output, current UID and no active pytest lock","files":before,"bytes":sum(item["bytes"] for item in before),"preserved_failed_test":failed,"physical_experiments":0}
(output / "before-inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps(inventory,indent=2)+"\n")
removed = []
for entry in sorted(temporary.iterdir()):
    if entry.name == failed:
        continue
    if entry.is_symlink():
        if entry.resolve() == temporary / failed:
            continue
        entry.unlink()
    elif entry.is_dir():
        shutil.rmtree(entry)
    else:
        entry.unlink()
    removed.append(entry.name)
for item in preserved:
    path = temporary / item["path"]
    assert path.stat().st_size == item["bytes"] and file_digest(path) == item["sha256"]
result = {"schema":"nisayon.test-temporary-cleanup.v1","completed_at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"root":str(temporary),"command_run":run_id,"inventory_sha256":file_digest(output / "before-inventory.json"),"temporary_bytes_before":inventory["bytes"],"failed_test_bytes_preserved":sum(item["bytes"] for item in preserved),"removed_entries":removed,"scope":"Only passing-test temporary copies from this identified completed run. Original source artifacts, failed test files, other pytest roots and other-session artifacts were not changed.","resource_violation":"The full suite retained 1.61 GiB in its temporary root; combined measured new payload was about 1.78 GiB, exceeding the 1 GiB bound. Cleanup does not erase that overrun."}
(output / "cleanup.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k != "removed_entries"},indent=2))
cost_boundary: wall time for this command; human time and external costs unmeasured
